snippet.title: Cozy Archivist Simulator — Sandbox Gameplay Trailer | Cozy First-Person Organizing Simulator
snippet.description:
Cozy Archivist Simulator is a first-person cozy organizing simulator about sorting documents, arranging files, and restoring order in a quiet archive. Open boxes, handle stacks of records, follow filing rules, and place every document where it belongs.

In this single-player indie game, you work step by step through archive rooms filled with misplaced files. Sort documents by category, date, number, and other rules while enjoying a calm, satisfying gameplay loop focused on order, attention, and cozy atmosphere.

The game features both Sandbox Mode and Campaign Mode.

In Sandbox Mode, you choose a level and organize archive rooms with their own layout, atmosphere, and filing rules. Each level offers a different way to sort, arrange, and restore order.

In Campaign Mode, you have more freedom in how the archive is organized. Instead of simply following fixed rules, you create your own structure, decide where things belong, and build a system that makes sense to you. The game then gives you search tasks that test how well your archive works — without timers, pressure, or taking away your freedom.

Key Features

• First-Person Archive Work
Step into the role of an archive worker and organize shelves, boxes, files, and records from a first-person perspective.

• Satisfying Organization Gameplay
Turn messy shelves and scattered documents into a clean, structured archive.

• Filing Rules and Sorting Challenges
Follow different archive rules, sort files by categories and dates, and learn how each section should be arranged.

• Cozy and Relaxing Atmosphere
No rush, no pressure — just calm document sorting, soft ambience, and the satisfaction of restoring order.

• Single-Player Indie Simulator
A focused organizing game for players who enjoy cozy games, job simulators, sorting games, and satisfying cleanup gameplay.
